method: Player/shadow origin follows each explicit camera distance station, with atmosphere advanced only once per face/profile: cloud/wind phase stays fixed between stations (not a continuous walk). This isolates the local shadow coverage/self-bias issue in addition to material fade. Actual rendered frames, three distinct façade patches, six real camera distances, fixed sun/weather/profile/player/shadow origin. Lens FOV compensates distance to keep the same 24 cm world patch and pixel footprint, isolating distance-based material fade from texture minification; all FOVs recorded. Diagnostic camera inspections, not a walking route. Linear sRGB luminance measured from native WebGL pixels. No image edits.
